clauses.reason: First-ending judgment withheld: EO12792 §2(b) is only a reporting deadline, not an ending. Section 3(e), merged into the machine §3(c) span, terminates the Commission 30 days after actual submission. The dossier lacks the submission date and explicitly lacks EO12827 target provision, so neither the operative deadline as amended nor the actual first end is established. EO12869 §§4(a),6 formally revoke effective September 30, 1993, but that cannot displace an earlier report-triggered ending.
